views.createSql: CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT r.id AS transacao_id, date(r.dateEpochDay * 86400, 'unixepoch') AS data, CAST(strftime('%Y', r.dateEpochDay * 86400, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) AS ano, CAST(strftime('%m', r.dateEpochDay * 86400, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) AS mes, r.description AS descricao, r.merchantName AS estabelecimento, r.amountCents AS valor_centavos, r.amountCents / 100.0 AS valor, r.categoria_id AS categoria_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.categoria_id, '') = '' THEN 'Sem categoria' ELSE COALESCE(c.name, r.pluggyCategory, 'Sem categoria') END AS categoria, r.manual AS categoria_manual, g.name AS grupo_categoria, CASE WHEN r.transferencia = 1 THEN 'transferencia' WHEN r.amountCents < 0 THEN 'gasto' WHEN r.amountCents > 0 AND r.tipo_conta = 'cartao' THEN 'estorno' WHEN r.amountCents > 0 THEN 'entrada' ELSE 'neutro' END AS tipo, CASE WHEN r.transferencia = 1 THEN 0 WHEN r.amountCents < 0 OR r.tipo_conta = 'cartao' THEN -r.amountCents / 100.0 ELSE 0 END AS valor_gasto, CASE WHEN r.transferencia = 0 AND r.amountCents > 0 AND r.tipo_conta = 'conta' THEN r.amountCents / 100.0 ELSE 0 END AS valor_entrada, r.conta AS conta, r.tipo_conta AS tipo_conta, r.banco AS banco, CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pendente, r.installmentNumber AS parcela, r.totalInstallments AS total_parcelas FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(oc.id, t.pluggyCategoryId) AS categoria_id, CASE WHEN oc.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS manual, CASE WHEN COALESCE(oc.id, t.pluggyCategoryId, '') = '05100000' OR substr(COALESCE(oc.id, t.pluggyCategoryId, ''), 1, 2) IN ('03', '04') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS transferencia, CASE WHEN a.type = 'CREDIT' THEN 'cartao' ELSE 'conta' END AS tipo_conta, a.name AS conta, COALESCE(i.bankName, i.connectorName) AS banco FROM transaction_fact t LEFT JOIN account_dim a ON a.id = t.accountId LEFT JOIN item_dim i ON i.id = a.itemId LEFT JOIN category_override o ON o.transactionId = t.id LEFT JOIN category_dim oc ON oc.id = o.categoryId) r LEFT JOIN category_dim c ON c.id = r.categoria_id LEFT JOIN category_dim g ON g.id = substr(r.categoria_id, 1, 2) || '000000'
